{{Quote|Shara, come in. I've arrived safely on Mustafar. I can't say the same for the Super Star Destroyer, though.|X2|<ref name="ES">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>}}
This '''''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], this [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] became the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[X1]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] and aspiring [[Emperor/Legends|emperor]]. Following the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Liberation of Bespin|liberation]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], X1 used the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] to travel to [[Bast Castle]], the former retreat of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], on the [[Acid rain/Legends|acid rain]]-drenched [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] to learn the secrets of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

The [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] was later present above volcanic [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], the de facto [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[X1's faction]], during a New Republic [[Battle of Mustafar (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] on the planet. While New Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on the ground were busy dealing with X1's forces, the Imperials raised a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]]&mdash;used in conjunction with a separate [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] protecting X1's base&mdash;to prevent any New Republic reinforcements from arriving. X1's clone brother, [[X2]], infiltrated the Star Dreadnought following a decoy assault and used the Super [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] weapons to destroy the Imperials' [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield projectors]]. Although the base's shields went down, the planetary shield remained operational, prompting X2 to ram the warship into the defensive barrier. The move deactivated the shield and allowed the New Republic's reinforcements to land. The Super Star Destroyer was destroyed in the collision, and its burning remains settled on Mustafar's surface.

==Description==
This [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was an [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]], one of many [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]] serving the various fragments of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the wake of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It was used as a [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[X1]], an Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]].<ref name="ES-PSP" /> The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] featured an [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturret]] defensive grid, as well as a [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]]-activated alarm system capable of sealing off areas with [[Force field/Legends|force fields]] and locking down [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] near the source of the [[Laser/Legends|blasterfire]].<ref name="ES-DS" />

==History==
{{Quote|But the planetary shield is still up&mdash;you're still locked out, X2!''"<br />"''Not to worry&hellip; I have a plan.'' [&hellip;] ''The Super Star Destroyer's going to do the job of getting past the planetary shield for me&hellip; I'll see you on the other side!|[[Shara]] and X2|<ref name="ES" />}}
[[File:X1_Star_DestroyerMustafar.jpg|thumb|left|The Star Dreadnought collides with Mustafar's planetary shield.]]
Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the Battle of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the leaderless Empire began to fragment as various warlords tried to fill the power vacuum. One such breakaway warlord was the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive clone known only as X1, who quickly consolidated forces loyal to his command. Among the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] that came to form X1's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was this [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]]. Following the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Liberation of Bespin|liberation]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], X1 sought to learn the secrets of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. To accomplish the task, he ventured to [[Bast Castle]], the retreat of Palpatine's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. X1 used the Star Dreadnought to travel to the [[Acid rain/Legends|acid rain]]-soaked [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="ES-PSP" />

Some [[Time/Legends|time]] later, the warship was present above the volcanic world of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], the de facto [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of X1's empire. The New Republic launched an [[Battle of Mustafar (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] on Mustafar, hoping to defeat X1 and his forces. A wave of New Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] arrived on planet but was unable to advance on X1's base, which was being protected by a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]]. Additionally, the Imperials raised a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] that prevented the New Republic from landing reinforcements to assist the beleaguered troops. X1's clone brother, [[X2]]&mdash;a longtime enemy of the Empire&mdash;devised a plan to deal with both enemy shields. Staging a decoy attack on the Imperial fleet, X2 infiltrated the Super [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] and fought his way to the warship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="ES-DS" />

On the bridge, X2 used the Star Dreadnought's weapons to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield projectors]] generating the Imperials' shield defenses. The clone succeeded in this task, but only the shield protecting X1's command center went down. With the planetary shield still active, X2 opted to ram the Super Star Destroyer into the barrier. The impact brought down the shield and destroyed the Imperial warship, whose remains settled onto the lava plains on Mustafar's surface. With the Imperials' defenses down, the New Republic was able to land its reserves and defeat X1's forces. X2, meanwhile, escaped the destruction of the Star Dreadnought and went on to defeat his clone brother after a brief [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], ending the threat of X1's empire.<ref name="ES-DS" />

==Commanders and crew==
[[File:X2MakesAnEntrance-BFES.jpg|thumb|right|X2 walks away from the wreckage of the Star Dreadnought.]]
This Super Star Destroyer was commanded by X1, a Force-sensitive [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who had fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and served under the Empire in the years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following Emperor Palpatine's death at Endor, X1 was one of many Imperial leaders who declared themselves warlords and sought to become the new Emperor. He used this warship as his command ship.<ref name="ES-PSP" /> Additionally, many [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] served aboard the Star Dreadnought.<ref name="ES-DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This unidentified ''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought appeared in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''. For the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]] version of the game, in which the ship only appears in two cutscenes, reused shots of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader's [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] from [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] were used to depict X1's Star Dreadnought. The warship plays a more prominent role in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of the game, which established its destruction during the Battle of Mustafar.
